import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static long calculate(long n) {
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        long base = 1, digits = 1;
        while (base <= n) {
            base = base * 10 + 1;
            digits++;
        }
        digits--;
        base = (base - 1) / 10;
        if (base == n) return digits;
        long min_moves = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        if ((base * 10 + 1 - n) < n) {
            min_moves = calculate(base * 10 + 1 - n) + digits + 1;
        }
        long multiplier = 1;
        long candidate_value;
        while (base * multiplier <= n) {
            candidate_value = base * multiplier;
            multiplier++;
        }
        multiplier--;
        long alternative = calculate(n - candidate_value) + digits * (multiplier - 1);
        return Math.min(min_moves, alternative);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long val = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(calculate(val));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
